text:
Josh Morrissey is back. The Jets' top defenseman returns tonight against New Jersey after missing 14 games (Daily Faceoff, Sportsnet), and the timing is kind: Winnipeg has won three straight after an eight-game winless run that happened almost entirely without him.

He played four games before the injury, with three assists, and left the last one after 9.5 minutes. That's too small a sample to say anything about this season. Last season is the better guide: Evolving-Hockey had him 17th among 215 defensemen in wins above replacement, most of it from even-strength offense.

What he gives Winnipeg is the thing it lacked during the skid: someone who moves the puck. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 61% of his exits leaving the zone with possession and 6.0 primary shot assists per 60 last season (86th percentile among defensemen). Our projection, assuming he plays the rest of the way, is about 39 points. We'd watch his minutes in the first two games back.
